comment: Signatures of the game's code that font replacement hooks, shared by FontChanger.DalamudPlugin and XivAlexander. Each pattern (its parts concatenated) is a regex over the bytes of the game's .text section that must match exactly once; it must work the same in SRELL (dotall), .NET Regex (Singleline, over Latin-1 text) and Python re (bytes, re.S). A signature resolves (resolve) to the match's start (match), the start of the function containing it, by the unwind data (function), the position of its capture of type position (capture), or to nothing, its captures being all that is used (none). Captures are the regex's groups in order; a name given to several groups, in alternatives, is what the one that matched captured, and a group that didn't match captures nothing. An offset is a little-endian signed displacement (of the group's size, 1 or 4 bytes) of a field, named Structure.Field, or of a field relative to another, named Structure.Field-Structure.Other (the first minus the second); a size, a structure's size; a count, a number of elements; a rel32, a target relative to the end of the group; a position, an empty group's address.

Resolves to the function containing the match. Holds since 2020.07 (5.3x). Since 7.40 the layout looks the substitutes up in the glyph map itself; before, a function of its own (FallbackGlyph) does. Before 7.00 the secondary font is handled by a function of its own too (SecondaryGlyph), so its offsets don't capture.
